patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Notion and Smartsheet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Notion and Smartsheet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Notion only if your buying job matches “Docs-first workspace with databases and light project tracking — Plus from $10/user/mo ann” rather than Smartsheet's shape. Choose Smartsheet only if your buying job matches “Spreadsheet-style work management with Gantt, portfolios and automation — Pro from $9/memb” rather than Notion's shape. Workflow advantage: Notion leans team-collaboration-work; Smartsheet leans project-tracking, resource-planning. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Notion and Smartsheet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Notion is Docs-first workspace with databases and light project tracking — Plus from $10/user/mo annual; AI on Business.; Smartsheet is Spreadsheet-style work management with Gantt, portfolios and automation — Pro from $9/member/mo annual..
- Company-size focus: Notion (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Smartsheet (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Notion-leaning team-collaboration-work vs Smartsheet-leaning project-tracking, resource-planning, timeline-reporting.
- Researched limits: Notion — Not a full Work OS for portfolio/resource management; Smartsheet — No free plan.

Limitations — Notion: Not a full Work OS for portfolio/resource management; Reporting/dashboards thinner than dedicated PM tools; Smartsheet: No free plan; Business tier pricing jump.

Poor-fit cases: Notion is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a full Work OS for portfolio/resource management · Smartsheet is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No free plan · Avoid Notion if you actually need Smartsheet's motion (Spreadsheet-style work management with Gantt, portfolios and automation — Pro fr)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
